Internal helper: draw a 100% stacked bar

Source: R/plot.R
dot-jst_build_stacked.Rd

Ruling R68 (Session 412; its orientation ruled Session 413): horizontal bars in their natural order, the first at the top; each bar's segments its categories in order, dark to light, summing to 100 percent of the bar's whole; the look's axes and gridlines, turned for bars that run across; the legend ABOVE the chart in the segments' order, in both built-in styles (an amendment of ruling R64 for this kind). No values in the segments unless the style's values.stacked says yes, and then none in a segment under 6 percent (ruling R70).

Usage

.jst_build_stacked(
  counts,
  bar_labels = NULL,
  bar_title = NULL,
  legend_title = NULL,
  sheet_names = c("Group", "Category"),
  look = .jst_plot_look_now()
)

Arguments

counts

A list as .jst_plot_stacked_counts() returns.

bar_labels

Named character; each bar's label on the axis.

bar_title

Character(1) or NULL; the title of the bars' axis.

legend_title

Character(1) or NULL.

sheet_names

Character(2); the heads of the data sheet's bar and category columns.

look

A look.

Value

The chart, as a builder returns it (.jst_plot_built()).
